name.en: NMNS Botanical Garden — Tropical Rainforest Greenhouse
name.zh-TW: 國立自然科學博物館植物園—熱帶雨林溫室

entries.firstRead: Tall broad greenhouse silhouette, base wider than top; curved glass face with sloping side supports, not a round dome.
An open pedestrian street gap framed by two dense rows of low shopfronts, with ordinary taller city buildings behind.
Broad quiet lake with muted green water, edged by rounded pale stones.

name.zh-TW: 文心森林公園／圓滿戶外劇場

entries.firstRead: Low, broad white canopy made of layered curling shell/ribbon surfaces, with elongated dark slots between them.
Compact three-bay frontage with a taller central roof section and lower roof sections to both sides.
Low, broad ochre/orange tiled roof with restrained upturned corners; less exuberant than Wanhe roof ornament.
Very broad, symmetrical double-eaved main-hall silhouette with gold/yellow glazed roof planes.

name.en: Taichung Prefectural Hall / Old Taichung City Hall

entries.firstRead: A street-corner central entrance mass with two long two-story wings extending away to left and right.
Compact raised hexagonal/radial core with several low market wings/aisles, rather than a single giant shop.

name.en: Cultural Heritage Park, Ministry of Culture — Former Taichung Brewery
name.zh-TW: 文化部文化資產園區—臺中舊酒廠

entries.firstRead: Several low connected industrial buildings of unequal heights, with triangular pitched gables and utilitarian flat connecting roofs.
